cohort: 107 term and preterm infants 0-28 days old who were treated and followed-up in the neonatal intensive care unit of a hospital between January 2014 and December 2019.
finding: Hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy was the most common cause of neonatal convulsions in the study, but congenital metabolic diseases were detected at a high rate.
mod_finding: 35.5% of infants were born by caesarean section.
